verse.verse_1: Exalt the Name of your Lord, the Highest,
verse.verse_5: then made it dry dark, flaky stubble,
verse.verse_6: We shall make you recite so that you will not forget,
verse.verse_7: except what Allah wills, surely, He knows all that is (spoken) aloud and what is hidden.
verse.verse_8: We shall ease you to the easy.
verse.verse_9: Therefore remind, if the Reminder benefits,
verse.verse_10: and he who fears shall remember,
verse.verse_11: but the most wretched shall avoid it,
verse.verse_12: who will roast in the Great Fire,
verse.verse_13: in which he will neither die nor live therein.
verse.verse_14: Prosperous is he who purifies himself,
verse.verse_15: and remembers the Name of his Lord, so he prays.
verse.verse_16: But you prefer the present life,
verse.verse_17: but the Everlasting Life is better, and more enduring.
verse.verse_18: Surely, this is in the ancient Scrolls,
verse.verse_19: the Scrolls of Abraham and Moses.
